clues: This city fills a main island just north of the equator, in the south east of Asia. More than sixty small isles sit around it in warm seas.
This place has no true seasons at all. Heat, damp air, and rain stay much the same all year, with a wetter monsoon time in winter months.
This island was cast out of a joint land in 1965. It then stood on its own as a free land, with this city at its heart.
This one city is a whole country by itself. It stands free on its island, with no far towns or farm lands ruled from afar.
Its own parliament sits in this city and makes the laws for the whole land. That is so because the city and the land are one.
